caption: The video captures a close-up of a compression-testing apparatus set against a green wall with a door handle on the right. A polished steel ram sits above a ribbed transparent acrylic cage over a clear upper plate marked by a black seal line. Between this plate and a fixed clear lower plate lies a horizontal band of lavender-purple material fringed with white, frothy crushed edges, all supported by a steel base. Throughout, the ribbed cage and upper plate move steadily downward, while the lower plate and base remain motionless. The black seal line descends gradually toward the lower plate, narrowing the vertical gap holding the purple band. As the squeeze continues, the purple core's top surface lowers and its thickness visibly reduces. The white margins along the sides remain frayed and uneven. The compression proceeds smoothly and continuously as the upper assembly descends.
relations: The ribbed cage and upper plate descend steadily, narrowing the vertical gap holding the purple material.
The lower plate and steel base remain motionless, providing a fixed foundation for the compression.
As the black seal line moves downward, the purple core's thickness visibly reduces.
The white, frothy margins along the sides remain frayed and uneven during the squeeze.
